subtitle: Out Manila · Juneyao Airlines
overview: This 6-day winter tour flies Juneyao Airlines from Manila to Shanghai. You visit Hangzhou’s West Lake, enjoy tea tasting and a Hanfu experience at Meijiawu, and ski at Yunshang Grassland Ski Resort in Anji (ski equipment included, snow suits not). You then see Wuzhen by night and spend a full day at Shanghai Disneyland. Hotels are 5-star, with a free upgrade to Yuyuan hot pot and a BBQ meal.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Dec 19–24 2026 to Feb 14–19 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.World’s Largest Starbucks Flagship Store: A large Starbucks flagship store in Shanghai visited as a photo and coffee stop.
placeDesc.Nanjing Road: Shanghai's best-known pedestrian shopping street, running toward the Bund.
placeDesc.The Bund: Shanghai's riverfront promenade, with historic buildings facing the modern Pudong skyline.
placeDesc.Oriental Pearl Tower: Shanghai's landmark TV tower in Pudong, with a photo stop on this tour.
placeDesc.West Lake: Hangzhou's famous lake, where the tour includes a stroll along the shore.
placeDesc.Hangzhou West Lake New World: A modern waterfront development by West Lake in Hangzhou, with a photo stop.
placeDesc.Leifeng Tower: A pagoda on the shore of West Lake in Hangzhou, seen from outside.
placeDesc.Meijiawu Tea Culture Village: A tea-growing village near Hangzhou with tea tasting and a Hanfu experience.
placeDesc.Yunshang Grassland Ski Resort: A ski resort in Anji, Zhejiang; ski equipment is included but snow suits are not.
placeDesc.Wuzhen Water Town: A canal town in Zhejiang, visited for its night view.
placeDesc.Chenghuang Temple Business Area: A traditional-style shopping area around the Chenghuang Temple in Shanghai's old city.
placeDesc.Shanghai Disneyland: Disney theme park in Shanghai; a whole day with ticket, transfer and tour guide included.
placeDesc.Lujiazui Financial Center Sky Corridor: A sky-high walkway between towers in Shanghai's Lujiazui financial district.
